note: Realistic prompts for trying the kit by hand or with a sub-agent. Replace the bracketed paths with real ones.

evals.prompt: 帮我 deep dive 这篇 paper，我要完全了解里面的细节，不是只懂 summary：[path/to/paper.pdf]
evals.expected_output: A run folder whose dossier passes the lint: every page read, every part with its mechanism, failure paths, a worked example and newcomer questions; statements checked against primary sources marked verified or corrected; then one scope page with at most four questions.

evals.prompt: I only want section 10 of this paper (the safety and permissions part). Research it in full detail and tell me what is out of date: [path/to/paper.pdf]
evals.expected_output: The section's page range recorded as `pages:` in the sources index and read in full; corrections listed with what the paper claims and what the primary source says now; no gap filled in with a guess.

evals.prompt: I don't have a paper for this one. I want to really understand how prompt caching works in LLM APIs, end to end. Go find the sources yourself.
evals.expected_output: Primary sources found and listed (official documentation, not blog posts); no `provided` source; a dossier at the same depth as for a paper.

evals.prompt: The dossier in ./deep-dive-parcel-lockers is done. Show me the scope before you build anything.
evals.expected_output: One short page (numbers, the map, a coverage table with everything in, corrections and gaps, the settings), followed by one round of at most four questions; scope.md written only after the answers.
